results.summary: This is a 4x4 BitNet b1.58 matrix multiply accelerator controlled over SPI. It multiplies unsigned 8-bit activations by ternary {-1,0,+1} weights using a multiplier-free add/sub/skip datapath with two parallel compute lanes. The design is implemented in Verilog and uses 1x2 tiles. It is intended for edge AI inference, and the documentation describes the SPI command format and a 32-cycle compute latency.

results.summary: This project is a roulette-style LED spinner on a seven-segment display with variable speeds. The wheel spins continuously and its speed is set by four input bits, while a stop input triggers a pseudo-random LFSR-chosen stopping position. Users make guesses on the bidirectional pins, and a correct guess lights the decimal point on the display. The design is implemented in Verilog and tested with per-module testbenches and gtkwave.
